source_title: Chopper with six on board crashes near Uttarakhand’s Joshimath
source_excerpt: New Delhi A helicopter carrying six persons crashed near Joshimath in Uttarakhand on Friday (October 30, 2026), killing all occupants, including the pilot. Preliminary reports suggest that bad weather may have caused the accident. Five of the victims were pilgrims from Karnataka. Chamoli District Magistrate Gaurav Kumar said the helicopter, operated by private firm Trans Bharat Aviation, was flying from Badrinath to the Sahastradhara helipad in Dehradun when it crashed around 1.45 p.m. Helicopter-related accidents in Uttarakhand over the years: A timeline Helicopter-related accidents in Uttarakhand over the years: A timeline A list of multiple helicopter-related incidents in and around Uttarakhand over the years Helicopter-related accidents in Uttarakhand over the years: A timeline storyline 1 “The wreckage was located near an Army camp above Chai village. Mr. Dhami has also directed the officials concerned to conduct a detailed investigation. He also instructed the district administration to provide every possible assistance to the affected families. Uttarakhand Congress senior vice-president Suryakant Dhasmana blamed alleged government negligence and questioned the aviation safety measures, particularly on the Char Dham pilgrimage routes. In a statement, he said 13 people died in five helicopter-related incidents in Uttarakhand over a 45-day period in 2025. Mr. Dhasmana also cited accident data indicating that four of the eight helicopter accidents recorded in the Char Dham sector between 2015 and 2025 occurred in 2025.
